name: 33524-sharedprefix-gptoss120b-8gpu
hardware: 8x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one whole a3 node, --gres=gpu:8), sm90.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One vLLM engine on one node, drafter co-resident with the target.
architecture: Sparse MoE decoder (GptOssForCausalLM), 36 layers, hidden 2880, 128 experts with 4 active per token, mxfp4 expert weights (~61 GB); drafter is a 787 M LlamaForCausalLMEagle3 head.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1100 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. Static seed 33270.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, temperature 0: one 200-token prefix shared by every request (`prefix_count: 1`), then 800 tokens unique to the request, then exactly 200 output tokens under `ignore_eos`.
purpose: A document question-answering assistant on a shared instruction prefix, serving 64 concurrent users with speculative drafting across eight GPUs.
launch:
# Engine: source checkout of 7320ca3942d008a59c24da3305c81810cb586c9d
# (`git describe --tags` gives v0.16.0rc0-90-g7320ca3942d0), named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
#
# A structured value must stay on ONE line: this file is read line by line and indented
# continuation lines are skipped, so re-flowing one into a block mapping drops the key silently
# and the engine starts without it at rc=0.

model: openai/gpt-oss-120b
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "nvidia/gpt-oss-120b-Eagle3-short-context", "num_speculative_tokens": 3}
tensor-parallel-size: 8
max-num-seqs: 128
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
